## Answer

**Nothing calls `CreateOrderCommandHandler` directly except MediatR and one unit test** — it is reached only as the MediatR `IRequestHandler<CreateOrderCommand, bool>` for `CreateOrderCommand` (`src/Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:6-7`, registered by assembly scan at `src/Ordering.API/Extensions/Extensions.cs:35-41`). But a large fan-in and fan-out hangs off that one seam, including three other services.

### Upstream — what reaches it (callers)

| Layer | Evidence |
|---|---|
| MediatR dispatch of the inner command | `src/Ordering.API/Application/Commands/IdentifiedCommandHandler.cs:87` (`_mediator.Send(command)`), with `CreateOrderCommand` special-cased for logging at `:58-61` |
| Idempotency wrapper handler | `CreateOrderIdentifiedCommandHandler : IdentifiedCommandHandler<CreateOrderCommand, bool>` — `src/Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:57-62` |
